constraints: Keep final Heart success as the action-learning and acceptance objective. Intermediate HP/survival would be auxiliary supervision only, never a floor/death-stage reward replacing Heart. E176 failed gate remains failed. No new native replay, MCTS call, game or optimizer update.
limits: The endpoint is the first subsequent already-audited direct mapped monster/elite/boss combat, not necessarily the next physical battle: event fights can occur before it. Parent actions between card and endpoint, different rooms, resource changes and post-combat settlement are included. These correlated targets are not isolated card-mechanics causal effects, extra independent games, or proof that denser labels improve a policy.
